import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Load the data
data = """date,time,product,size,price,quantity,payment_method,customer_age_group,is_takeaway,total
2024-01-01,00:00,Cappuccino,Large,4.18,2,Credit Card,55+,1,8.36
2024-01-01,02:00,Cappuccino,Medium,4.01,3,Credit Card,35-44,1,12.03
2024-01-01,04:00,Tea,Small,5.22,1,Credit Card,18-24,1,5.22
2024-01-01,06:00,Latte,Large,6.37,2,Credit Card,45-54,1,12.74
2024-01-01,08:00,Americano,Medium,7.07,3,Cash,45-54,1,21.21"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", n_colors=5)

# 1. Total Sales by Product
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product')
for i, v in enumerate(product_sales.values):
    ax1.text(v + 0.3, i, f'${v:.2f}', va='center', fontsize=10)

# 2. Sales by Customer Age Group
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors[:len(age_sales)],
                                    explode=[0.05]*len(age_sales))
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group')

# 3. Price vs Quantity with Size encoding
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
size_map = {'Small': 100, 'Medium': 200, 'Large': 300}
sizes = df['size'].map(size_map)
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['price'], df['quantity'], s=sizes, c=range(len(df)), 
                      cmap='viridis', alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax3.set_xlabel('Price ($)')
ax3.set_ylabel('Quantity')
ax3.set_title('Price vs Quantity (Size = Drink Size)')

# Add legend for sizes
for size_name, size_val in size_map.items():
    ax3.scatter([], [], s=size_val, c='gray', alpha=0.7, label=size_name, edgecolors='black')
ax3.legend(title='Drink Size', loc='upper right')

# Add product labels
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax3.annotate(row['product'], (row['price'], row['quantity']), 
                 xytext=(5, 5), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=8)

# 4. Payment Method Distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
payment_counts = df.groupby('payment_method')['total'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
x = range(len(payment_counts))
width = 0.35
bars2 = ax4.bar([i - width/2 for i in x], payment_counts['count'], width, 
                label='Number of Orders', color=colors[0])
ax4_twin = ax4.twinx()
bars3 = ax4_twin.bar([i + width/2 for i in x], payment_counts['sum'], width, 
                     label='Total Sales ($)', color=colors[2])
ax4.set_xlabel('Payment Method')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Orders', color=colors[0])
ax4_twin.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', color=colors[2])
ax4.set_xticks(x)
ax4.set_xticklabels(payment_counts.index)
ax4.set_title('Orders and Sales by Payment Method')
ax4.legend(loc='upper left')
ax4_twin.legend(loc='upper right')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
